qti-item-body.p: A science-planning item asks the student to arrange investigation steps in order.

qti-order-interaction.qti-prompt: A science class is planning a fair test of how light affects seedling growth. Put the investigation steps in the best order.
qti-order-interaction.qti-simple-choice: Set up identical trays with the same soil, seed type, and water schedule.
Place one tray in full light and one tray in reduced light for the same number of days.
Measure and compare seedling height at the end of the trial.
Write a conclusion before collecting any measurements.
